race.description: Pj's Fruit & Veg Country Boosted (Bm66) Hcp
race.comment: DANCE GAVIN DANCE (4) has been freshened up since coming with a well-timed run to score over 1000m at Casino 39 days ago. Kept up to the mark with a subsequent Grafton trial. Promising sprinter who is in the right race to add to his impressive record. PATRIOTICINTENTION (2) returned from a 38-day let-up last time out and missed the frame for the first time in a while over 1175m at Grafton. Loves the heavy going and will strip fitter following that last outing. Poses a big threat. HUMPHREE BEAR (8) stuck on well to just miss the placings when fresh from a spell over 1000m at Grafton recently. Expected to be competitive out to this trip with that run under the belt. THEIR FINEST HOUR (6) scored two massive wins over shorter trips then led and was collared late when extended to 1115m at Grafton last time. In the mix but the last 100m is the issue. BEER BARON (7) returned to form last start and can never be ruled out of a race like this.
